'''Conners''' was a crewmember of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']]. Conners survived the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] passage to [[otherspace]], but was dragged off by shadows aboard the ''[[Desolate]]''.
